comment.body:
The dialog is just a piece of UI, it shouldn't listen to app lifecycle or know anything about the publishers state. It just receives the state describing the message it should display and how the button presses should be handled. So, something should own the responsibility of bridging publisher logic to UI, and AbcvlibActivity is the only place i see fit for this. Moving UI logic to PublisherManager sounds unwise. Also, was not aware that publishers are meant to be optional, so my bad.
The only option to make activity leaner that I see is creating a separate failure handler that will own that responsibility and will be attached/activated only if there are publishers hooked into the app. Sounds like a decent idea to me, so let's see how it will look
